name: logo-upload
title: Logo Upload
description: A compound component for uploading logos or profile images with avatar preview, powered by useFileUpload.

docs.lead: A compound component for uploading logos or profile images. Shows a rounded avatar preview with placeholder, title, description, and action buttons. Designed to work with the useFileUpload hook.
docs.usage:
import * as LogoUpload from "@/components/ui/logo-upload" import * as Button from "@/components/ui/button" import { useFileUpload } from "@/hooks/use-file-upload" const upload = useFileUpload({ ... }) const file = upload.files[0] Business logo

Supports JPEG or PNG files (max 3 MB).

api.name: LogoUpload.Root
api.description: The outer container with border and padding.

api.name: LogoUpload.Preview
api.description: Renders a rounded avatar showing the uploaded image or a placeholder icon.

props.name: file
props.description: The file state from useFileUpload. Shows preview/url when available, otherwise shows placeholder.

props.name: placeholderType
props.description: The placeholder icon type when no image is available.

props.name: avatarColor
props.description: The background color of the placeholder avatar.

api.name: LogoUpload.Content
api.description: Wraps the title, description, and actions.

api.name: LogoUpload.Description
api.description: Container for description paragraphs (file requirements, size hints).

api.name: LogoUpload.Actions
api.description: Container for action buttons (Change, Retry, etc.).

api.name: LogoUpload.Item
api.description: Composed preset that renders the full logo upload layout from props.

props.name: file
props.description: The file state from useFileUpload. Shows uploaded image when available.

props.name: description
props.description: Description content rendered below the title.

props.name: placeholderType
props.description: The placeholder icon type when no image is available.

props.name: avatarColor
props.description: The background color of the placeholder avatar.

props.name: onButtonClick
props.description: Click handler for the action button (typically upload.openFilePicker).
